mountains.name: Kanaat massif (Dwargon)
mountains.basis: Dwargon is the dwarves' kingdom inside the Kanaat Mountains. The capital is carved into the range. The painted map draws the range as a pictorial symbol several hundred kilometres across (kept here as paintedSymbol). The atlas keeps a compact range: an impassable core about 44 x 40 km around the capital, foothills to about 66 x 60 km, summit near 2,900 synthetic metres (scripts/cartography/build_terrain.py). The magitanks array at the gate about thirty kilometres from the city centre (v13.txt:513-515), just beyond the main gate at the foot of the range.

passes.name: Southern road pass
passes.basis: The Tempest-Dwargon road and magic train line (v12.txt:3279-3281) climb from the southern foot of the range into the capital carved in the mountain.

passes.name: Main gate valley
passes.basis: A valley from the main gate at the south-western foot of the range up to the capital. The gate stands about twenty kilometres from the city centre, below where the magitanks array (v13.txt:513-515).

passes.name: Eastern road pass
passes.basis: The road from the Isthmus and the eastern gate enters the range from the east and climbs to the capital.

lakes.name: Lake east of Rimuru
lakes.basis: The long lake east of the Tempest capital on the painted map and on the territories map. Not named in the corpus used here.

rivers.name: Eastern Jura river
rivers.basis: The main river on the painted map: it leaves the massif's eastern flank, runs south-east past the deep forest, then south.

rivers.name: Lake outflow (east)
rivers.basis: The channel from the lake's eastern end to the main river on the painted map.

rivers.name: Lake outflow (west)
rivers.basis: The channel from the lake's western end past the Tempest capital towards the south-west on the painted map.

crossings.name: Upper ford of the eastern river
crossings.basis: Where the imperial line of march from the border meets the river. The army must cross it to reach the forest edge.

crossings.name: Lower ford of the eastern river
crossings.basis: A second crossing south of the lake outflow, for movements towards the south-east.

crossings.name: Lake outflow ford
crossings.basis: The narrow channel between the lake and the main river.

crossings.name: Rimuru bridge
crossings.basis: The Tempest capital lies on the western outflow. The city's roads must cross it.

forests.name: Great Jura Forest
forests.basis: Forest cover of the Jura basin on the painted map, from the massif's southern foothills to the southern grasslands.

forests.name: Eastern deep forest
forests.basis: The densest stand on the painted map, east of the eastern river.

roads.name: Tempest-Dwargon road
roads.basis: Tempest's road and magic train line to Dwargon, about 1,000 km (v12.txt:3279-3281). The strategic supply link between the two allies.

roads.name: Tempest-Blumund highway
roads.basis: The highway from Tempest to the Kingdom of Blumund.

roads.name: Imperial highway
roads.basis: Links the imperial capital to the border assembly area the army marched from.

roads.name: Isthmus road
roads.basis: From the border assembly area across the isthmus to Dwargon's eastern gate.
